description: US ZIP+4 Lookup and Address Validator — Get a standardized US address and ZIP+4 from your Lob address-verification account. Check one street address with a suite or up to 20 CSV rows. Results flag missing and incorrect units. The built-in USPS example shows Suite 215 at 4420 Hotel Circle Ct.

csv.description: Up to 20 addresses. Header columns are street, unit, city, state, zip. Extra columns are ignored. Each row needs a street and either ZIP or city and state.

lob_api_key.description: Lob live publishable API key authorized for your organization's address verification.

mode.description: Example returns the previously verified USPS demonstration. Lookup verifies your input live.

unit.description: Apartment or suite, for example STE 215.

zip.description: Five-digit ZIP or full ZIP+4. Preserve leading zeros.

name: zip4-lookup
